look_here_first: Look for a dry-country perennial prairie clover with pinnate leaves, noticeably downy foliage, and compact purple-violet flower spikes; mature calyx and leaflet characters help confirm it.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: mature calyx characters useful for confirmation

lookalikes.differences: Downy foliage plus compact purple spikes are the fast cues; final separation from similar Dalea should use leaflet and mature calyx characters.
